label: Shopee Reviews Scraper
title: Shopee Reviews Scraper: Ratings, Photos & Videos
metaDescription: Get Shopee reviews from any shop or product URL in 8 markets: stars, text, sub-ratings, photos, videos, variation and seller reply. No Shopee account.
intro: Paste a Shopee shop or product link from any of 8 markets and get its reviews: star rating, text, quality, seller and delivery sub-ratings, photos, videos, the variation bought, the reviewer and the seller's reply. Filter by stars, text or media; no Shopee account needed.
useCases: Spot product defects in 1–2 star reviews before you stock an item
Compare sellers of the same product on service and delivery
Collect review text and photos for product research

faq.q: Which Shopee countries does it support?
faq.a: Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam, Taiwan and Brazil. Each market was checked with a real shop before release.

faq.q: Can I scrape all reviews of a whole shop?
faq.a: Yes. Paste a shop link to get reviews across the shop's products, or a product link for one product, and set the maximum number of reviews per shop.

faq.q: Can I get only 1- and 2-star reviews?
faq.a: Yes. Pick the star ratings you want, and optionally keep only reviews with text or with photos and videos.

faq.q: Does it include the buyer's photos and the seller's reply?
faq.a: Yes. Each review has its photo and video links and the seller's reply when there is one, plus the product quality, seller service and delivery sub-ratings.

faq.q: Do I need a Shopee account?
faq.a: No. Paste product or shop links; no login or cookies.

officialApi: The Shopee Open Platform API is for sellers and approved partners managing their own shops; it does not give you the reviews of other shops. This actor reads the reviews any shopper can see, for any product or shop.
